Layered veneer pendant

32.5 cm wide, 26.5 cm high

Five bands of thin veneer on four 3.0 mm plywood supports, locked into 3.0 mm opal acrylic: a disc at the top and a ring at the bottom.

Veneer

Select a band to switch it between light and dark veneer.

Band lengths include the seam overlap and 1.7 mm extra for wrapping 0.55 mm veneer around the supports. The slits in the supports are 1.2 mm wide, and the middle band rests on a 2 mm ledge on each support that reaches 1.05 mm out.

Laser cutting

Cutting files for the Epilog Fusion Pro 48 (1219 × 914 mm bed). Plywood and acrylic parts are laid out on the stock sheets you choose; place each sheet in the top-left corner of the bed. Veneer bands aren't included. Outlines are offset by half the kerf, so slots and notches come out at their nominal size.
